definitions.explanation: The clear, viscous liquid surrounding the yolk of an egg, which turns white when cooked. Used in cooking and scientific contexts.

examples.japanese: {卵白|らんぱく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{泡立|あわだ}てる→泡立てる：06419_awadateru⟧。
⟦メレンゲ→メレンゲ：29702_merenge⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{卵白|らんぱく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Meringue is made with egg whites and sugar.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卵黄|らんおう}→卵黄：11976_ranou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{卵白|らんぱく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分|わ}けて→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦それぞれ→それぞれ：01453_sorezore⟧⟦{調理|ちょうり}する→調理する：26793_chourisuru⟧。
examples.english: Separate the yolk and white, then cook each one.

notes:
{卵白|らんぱく} is the formal/technical term for egg white.

FORMS:
{卵|らん} (egg) + {白|ぱく} (white). Pairs with ⟦{卵黄|らんおう}→卵黄：11976_ranou⟧ (egg yolk).

FORMAL VS EVERYDAY:
- {卵白|らんぱく}: egg white (formal, used in recipes, food science, medical contexts)
- ⟦{白身|しろみ}→白身：13692_shiromi⟧: egg white (everyday word, literally "white part")

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {卵白|らんぱく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{泡立|あわだ}てる→泡立てる：06419_awadateru⟧: to whip egg whites
- {卵白|らんぱく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧: to separate the egg white
- {卵白|らんぱく}⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧: egg white allergy
- ⟦メレンゲ→メレンゲ：29702_merenge⟧: meringue (whipped {卵白|らんぱく})

USAGE:
Most commonly seen in cooking instructions, nutritional information, allergy testing, and food science. In casual conversation, ⟦{白身|しろみ}→白身：13692_shiromi⟧ is more natural.
